_comment: Synthetic only. No real case data, ever (CLAUDE.md). Every span below is invented for this demo; any resemblance to a real subject is unintended. Written to contain both aggravating and mitigating facts, and one genuine information gap, so the analysis has something honest to find rather than a single planted answer.

spans.text: Section 18 (Relatives): Subject reports two siblings who are citizens and residents of a foreign country. Subject reports contact by messaging application approximately weekly, and one in-person visit in the last three years.

Investigator confirmed the two siblings reside abroad and are employed in the private sector. No indication either is affiliated with a foreign government, military, or intelligence service. Subject's contact pattern is consistent with ordinary family relations.
Section 20A (Foreign Business Activities): Subject answered 'No' to holding any financial interest in a foreign business.

During the subject interview, Subject stated they hold a 4 percent non-controlling interest in a family-owned import business located in the same foreign country, inherited in 2021. Subject stated they did not consider an inherited minority interest reportable and did not intend to omit it.

Corporate registry records list Subject as holding 4 percent of the referenced business. Records show no officer, director, or signatory role. Annual distributions over the last three years averaged the equivalent of USD 1,900.

Credit report shows one collection account opened 2023 in the amount of USD 4,180, related to a medical debt. Account shows a payment plan established 2024 and a current balance of USD 610, paid as agreed for fourteen consecutive months.
Subject stated the medical debt arose from an emergency procedure during a lapse in coverage between employers, and provided documentation of the payment plan.
The record does not contain a response from Subject's former employer regarding the dates of the coverage lapse. One employment verification request remains outstanding as of the date of this report.
